title: Staff Specialist IT
description:
Lead high\-impact support and automation initiatives for enterprise PLM applications. Drive DevOps excellence, manage production services, mentor talented teams, and accelerate operational efficiency through automation and AI\-powered solutions. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

 Key responsibilities in your new role
   

  

* Lead and mentor a team of DevOps, Automation, and PLM/Windchill support engineers, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and operational excellence.
* Own L2 support operations, including incident management, SLA adherence, escalation handling, root cause analysis, and issue resolution.
* Manage service requests related to user access, roles, workflows, configurations, reporting, and application support.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, and automation initiatives.
* Oversee CI/CD pipelines, release planning, deployment readiness, environment validation, and post\-release support activities.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using Python, SQL, scripting, Windchill REST APIs, and AI\-enabled tools.
* Monitor application performance, operational KPIs, incident trends, service request volumes, and backlog health through dashboards and reporting.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, service owners, application teams, infrastructure, security teams, and vendors to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Maintain and enhance operational documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge repositories.
* Coach and develop team members while promoting best practices in DevOps, support operations, and automation.


 Your profile
   

  

**Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of IT experience with strong expertise in DevOps, enterprise application support, automation, and production service management.
* 5\+ years of experience leading technical or support teams, including planning, workload management, mentoring, stakeholder engagement, and escalation handling.
* Proven experience in L2 support operations, incident management, SLA governance, root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, and service request fulfillment.
* Strong hands\-on scripting and automation skills using Python, Shell Scripting, PowerShell, SQL, PL/SQL, or similar technologies.
* Good understanding of Git\-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, release management, deployment processes, and change governance.
* Experience with application monitoring, operational reporting, dashboarding, KPI tracking, and service performance management.
* Preferred knowledge of PTC Windchill, including workflows, lifecycle management, access controls, team roles, groups, administration, and REST APIs.
* Exposure to AI\-driven automation and process optimization initiatives to improve operational efficiency and service delivery.
* Strong documentation skills, including development and maintenance of SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and training materials.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced production support environment, including shift\-based operations, release windows, critical incidents, and priority business escalations.


 \#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
   

  

 As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game\-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

title: Information Technology Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Radisson Hotel Group is an international hospitality company with more than 1,600 hotels in operation and under development across over 100 countries in EMEA and APAC. The Group is in a rapid growth phase, offering career opportunities within a wide portfolio of brands, including Radisson Blu, Radisson, Radisson RED, Park Plaza, Park Inn by Radisson, Country Inn \& Suites by Radisson, and others under the Radisson Hotels umbrella. Its service culture is built on the “Every Moment Matters” brand promise and the “Yes I Can!” ethos, focusing on memorable guest experiences. Radisson Rewards provides members with streamlined, day\-one benefits across the portfolio, while Radisson Meetings delivers 100% carbon\-neutral, personalized, professional, and memorable event solutions. The Group is committed to caring for people, communities, and the planet, aiming to achieve Net Zero by 2050 and advancing sustainable travel through verified Hotel Sustainability Basics across all properties.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Information Technology Executive internship role is an on\-site position based at Radisson Hotel Group in Ahmedabad. This role supports day\-to\-day IT operations within the hotel, including monitoring systems, assisting with hardware and software setup, and helping maintain secure, reliable network and server environments. The intern will provide first\-level technical support to team members, respond to service requests, and assist in diagnosing and resolving IT issues to minimize downtime and ensure smooth hotel operations. Responsibilities also include maintaining documentation of incidents and configurations, coordinating with external vendors or corporate IT when required, and contributing to implementation of IT policies and data security standards. The role offers hands\-on experience with hospitality IT systems and requires close collaboration with hotel departments to support guest services and internal processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Information Technology and IT Operations skills, with an interest in hospitality technology environments.
* Candidates should possess Troubleshooting and Technical Support skills to diagnose, resolve, and document user issues efficiently.
* Candidates should possess Network Administration skills to assist in managing wired and wireless networks, user access, and basic security configurations.
* Relevant educational background in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (ongoing or completed) is beneficial.
* Familiarity with operating systems (Windows, macOS), standard office software, and basic hardware installation is advantageous.
* Strong communication, customer service orientation, and the ability to collaborate with diverse teams in a fast\-paced hotel environment are required.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, maintain confidentiality, and follow IT policies and security guidelines is expected.

title: Document Controller & Platform Administrator (2-4 Years Experience)
description:
**Company Description** 





 Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and
 





 developing deep large\-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI,
 





 computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction
 





 industry with our innovative AI\-powered construction management solution,
 
**“Kael”** 

 — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with
 





 real\-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform,
 
**“Observance”** 

 , uses LiDAR scanning,
 





 thermal imaging, and AI\-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as\-built
 





 intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.
 





  





**Role Description** 





 We are looking for a technically strong
 
**Document Controller \& Platform Administrator** 

 to manage the complete documentation lifecycle on our construction projects and to serve as the primary interface between the project team and our AI\-powered project management platform. This role is critical: nearly all other team members come from construction backgrounds, and this person will be relied upon to support, guide, and troubleshoot their interactions with the platform — ensuring all project data is accurate, timely, and enabling AI\-driven project intelligence. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad.
 









**Responsibilities** 




**Platform Administration \& Team Enablement** 



* Act as the primary platform interface for all team members — civil, MEP, quality, safety, and design coordinators — supporting and guiding their day\-to\-day interactions with the platform.
* Ensure all relevant project documents are uploaded accurately and on time to enable AI validation, compliance checks, and document tracking.
* Configure and maintain document workflows, approval routing, and submission trackers within the platform.
* Monitor the completeness and accuracy of data entered by team members; flag gaps or inconsistencies to the Project Manager.
* Support onboarding and ongoing training of team members on platform workflows and document management procedures.
* Troubleshoot data entry issues and guide team members in correctly using the platform for their respective functions.



**Document Management \& Control** 



* Establish and maintain the project document management system (DMS), ensuring documents are correctly named, versioned, and archived.
* Control the receipt, registration, distribution, and archiving of all project documents including drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, contracts, and correspondence.
* Manage drawing revision control to ensure all site teams are working from the current approved revision at all times.
* Coordinate document review and approval cycles with clients, consultants, and contractors; track submission and response deadlines.
* Issue document transmittals and maintain a comprehensive transmittal register.



**Compliance, Reporting \& Handover** 



* Support RERA documentation workflows, ensuring project records remain audit\-ready for regulatory filings, milestone disclosures, and delivery commitments.
* Compile and maintain statutory document registers including permits, NOCs, authority approvals, and inspection certificates.
* Prepare documentation packages for client handover, third\-party audits, and RERA compliance reviews.
* Produce periodic document status and platform activity reports for the Project Manager and client.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 2–4 years of experience in document control, IT support, enterprise platform administration, or a closely related role. Experience on construction or infrastructure projects is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong proficiency with digital document management systems (Aconex, Procore, ProjectWise, SharePoint, or equivalent).
* Comfortable learning and administering new SaaS or agentic platforms; prior experience with AI\-powered project tools is a plus.
* Ability to communicate technical platform concepts clearly to non\-technical construction professionals.
* Understanding of construction documentation workflows — drawing registers, RFI processes, submittal cycles — is preferred.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and reliable with strong MS Office skills.



  





**Work Location : Ahmedabad (On\-site)**

title: Support Engineer 1
description:
**Job Description**
 Serves as a point of contact for customers, fielding inquiries via phone or electronic channels. Provides technical support by troubleshooting and resolving simple issues encountered with assigned Oracle product(s). Coordinates with more experienced peers to report and support the resolution of routine design, reliability, and maintenance issues. Maintains service request and/or product documentation and learns to create Knowledge Base articles and/or troubleshooting guides for resolving issues. Provides assistance to internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues. Learns to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues and begins to identify potential enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support and Solution Delivery\-Customer Support and Advocacy:**
* Serves as a point of contact for customers and facilitates customer relationship building, fielding inquiries via phone, electronic, or in\-person means.
* Provides technical support to customers by answering technical questions, troubleshooting and resolving simple issues related to assigned Oracle product(s).


**Technical Support and Solution Delivery\-Technical Problem\-Solving and Resolution:**
* Leverages basic understanding of problem resolution, which may include fix delivery and product certification to research, re\-create, and test technical issues for assigned product area(s) reported by customers to identify a resolution, with minimal guidance.

* Documents activities on service request and/or product documentation, learning to leverage troubleshooting guides and/or Knowledge Base articles, through resolution.
* Learns to prepare troubleshooting guides and/or create Knowledge Base articles for resolved issues.


**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement\-Technical Support Collaboration:**
* Begins to develop a deeper understanding of assigned Oracle product ecosystem(s) and customer environment(s).
* Provides assistance to internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues.

* Learns to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues.
* Begins to identify potential enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices, based on customer feedback and/or operational insights.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Completes assigned tasks and monitors timelines to ensure timely completion of work in accordance with project requirements, with supervision. Follows direction to prioritize work and adjust to shifts in resources or timelines.


**Collaboration \& Partnership:**
* Collaborates with team members to better understand expectations and contribute to shared objectives. Builds basic understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs with guidance.


**Problem Solving:**
* Follows standard procedures to identify and escalate issues to senior team members. Collects and reviews basic data and/or information to troubleshoot common errors.


**Continuous Learning:**
* Builds knowledge and learns new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices as directed. Incorporates feedback and participates in training to improve skills.

title: Architect / Draftsman
description:
JOB SUMMARY:
 



  





 Architectural Design \& Drafting Firm Seeks Architect/Draftsperson with 5 years Minimum Experience in Residential Field.
 



  





 COMPANY OVERVIEW:
 



  





 MGL is one of the leading outsourcing company specializing in Architectural drafting service providers for our clients located all over the globe.
 



  





 We are currently seeking talented Architect/Draftsman to join our team and contribute to our successful projects.
 



 This role will see the successful candidate work exclusively for an Architectural design firm in Australia. Scope of work is vast, we do large Prestige finish double storey residences but also do lots of smaller projects as well as a mixture of Commercial work. Our diverse range helps to creates exciting work opportunities, where staff get the experience \& learning opportunities that come from variety of projects, without feeling “stale” or “bored” by working on same tasks day to day.
 



  





 We pride ourselves on professional service \& producing detailed \& easy to understand drawings,working in a highly organised working environment – all within a professional but friendly and relaxed environment. If you are talented, have below qualities and would like to join our exciting company, then please submit your resume and portfolio to rs@mglgroup.com.au and pragati@mglgroup.com.au
 



  





 RESPONSIBILITY:
 



  Create detailed architectural drawings and plans.
 



  Collaborate with clients to understand their design requirements.
 



  Oversee the design process from concept to completion.
 



  Ensure adherence to building codes and regulations.
 



  Work independently and as part of a team.
 



  





 SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
 



  Bachelor’s degree in Architecture/Diploma in Architecture
 



  5 Year minimum experience in Residential projects.
 



  Proficiency on AutoCAD.
 



  Knowledge of photoshop, MS office and 3d software like Google SketchUp and rendering tools will be add on.
 



  Good time management skills, the ability to work to specific deadlines, and under pressure at times.
 



  Have a willingness to learn International Standards.
 



  Have a base level of English, and a desire to improve English skills both written and verbal.
 



  Well organized and highly motivated.
 



  Great attention to detail and accuracy in all work performed.
 



  Ability to work in a team environment and take direction when required.
 



  





 WORK ENVIRONMENT:
 



  Opportunity to work in a team of highly professional colleagues.
 



  A work environment to develop your skills and knowledge.
 



  Active, friendly and motivated group of employees.
 



  Know your work is making a difference to the company as a whole.
 



  Work\-life balance.
 



 Striking a healthy balance between work and personal life is important to us. It keeps us motivated and productive in the long term and thus contributes to our company's success. We support our employees in this aim: through flexible working time models, with care obligations towards dependents.
 



  





 KEY BENEFITS TO EMPLOYEES:
 



  One on one contact and direct training \& communication with our Australian client.
 



  Once trained, candidate will have knowledge of Australian Standards, which increases ones skillset and ability to work for other countries, like the USA, Canada and New Zealand.
 



  Senior role with opportunity to grow drafting team.

title: Embedded Hardware Engineer
description:
**About Oizom** 


 Oizom builds environmental monitoring hardware and software — air quality, noise, vibration, and gas\-sensing products deployed in the field across multiple markets. Our product line spans Polludrone (ambient air quality), Sonicbot (Class 1 noise monitoring), Seismibot (ground vibration), OGS (electrochemical gas sensing), Sensorbox, and AirOwl (our open\-source ESP32\-based air quality monitor). Our R\&D team spans Industrial Design, Design Engineering, Embedded Hardware, and Embedded Firmware.
 



**Role Summary** 


 We're hiring an Embedded Hardware Engineer to design and bring up analog and digital electronics for our sensor products. This is a primarily hands\-on role — schematic capture through board bring\-up and field validation — with room to mentor junior engineers and interns as the team grows.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
* Design schematics and PCB layouts for sensor front\-ends, power supplies, and MCU carrier boards (ESP32, STM32, CM4\-based designs)
* Select and qualify components — sensors, analog front\-ends, power ICs, connectors — balancing cost, availability, and field\-reliability requirements
* Bring up new boards: power\-on validation, signal integrity checks, debugging with oscilloscope/logic analyzer, and root\-causing failures
* Design and validate power supply stages (buck/boost/LDO, battery charging, solar/MPPT where applicable) for field\-deployed, often battery\- or solar\-powered devices
* Work with Embedded Firmware on sensor interfacing (I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-485/Modbus, SDI\-12\) and debug hardware/firmware boundary issues together
* Support DFM/DFT reviews with Design Engineering and coordinate with contract manufacturers during pilot builds
* Run environmental and reliability testing (thermal, humidity, vibration) relevant to outdoor\-deployed monitoring equipment
* Maintain schematics, BOMs, and design documentation to a standard other engineers can pick up


**Required Skills \& Experience** 
* 3–5 years of hands\-on embedded hardware design experience, from schematic capture through bring\-up
* Proficiency with a professional EDA tool (
 
**KiCad** 

 or
 
**Altium** 

 ) for schematic and PCB design
* Strong analog and digital circuit design fundamentals — power regulation, signal conditioning, sensor front\-ends, MCU support circuitry
* Working knowledge of
 
**ESP32** 

 and/or
 
**STM32** 

 reference designs and their power/peripheral requirements
* Comfortable with lab bring\-up and debug: oscilloscope, multimeter, logic analyzer, bench power supply
* Understanding of common embedded communication interfaces: I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-485
* Familiarity with DFM principles and working directly with contract manufacturers
* Ability to read datasheets and application notes and translate them into working designs
* Experience with battery\-powered or solar/MPPT\-charged field electronics
* Exposure to analog front\-ends for gas or electrochemical sensing
* Familiarity with EMI/EMC pre\-compliance testing and design for compliance
* Experience with environmental/outdoor\-rated enclosure and connector selection
* Prior experience in a startup or small\-team R\&D environment where you owned a design end\-to\-end

title: RevOps HubSpot Specialist
description:
Who we are
 
 York IE® is an investment and operating firm that combines a family of funds with a hands\-on operating platform to build and back software companies. With a 250\+ person in\-house team, AI and automation technology, deep ecosystem partnerships, and cross\-functional insights from thousands of engagements, York drives value creation for the private technology market.
 



  




 Perks \& Benefits
 * Certification sponsorship
* One Week paid vacation \+ other floating leave policies
* Flexible working hours
* Team Lunches and celebrations



  




 Job Overview
 
  





 RevOps HubSpot Specialist
 



*Revenue Operations (RevOps) — Specialist Level* 




 Department \& Reporting Line
 



 Department: Revenue Operations / GTM Team
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, India — Onsite
 



 Reports to: RevOps Lead
 



 Works with: Business CRM Analyst (Driver on delivery) and the RevOps Strategist / Client Owner (Approver) on every ticket, per the DACI model in the RevOps Delivery Process. Escalates directly and ad hoc to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



 We are hiring a RevOps HubSpot Specialist to execute hands\-on CRM configuration and GTM process builds for York IE's client engagements. This role is the core technical Contributor in the RevOps Delivery Process — building against well\-defined Jira stories across HubSpot's core hubs, self\-certifying QA, and growing into ownership of increasingly complex, multi\-hub builds under the guidance of a RevOps Lead.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 HubSpot CRM Configuration \& Build
 


1. Configure and administer core HubSpot modules — Sales Hub and Marketing Hub as the primary scope, with growing, guided exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, and CMS Hub.
2. Build workflows, sequences, lead scoring, list segmentation, pipelines, and property/field configuration against documented acceptance criteria.
3. Set up lead routing rules, lifecycle\-stage automation, and standard Marketing → Sales → Customer Success handoff logic.
4. Support HubSpot\-to\-Salesforce (or another adjacent tool) field mapping and sync troubleshooting under guidance from the Lead or a senior Specialist.



 GTM Execution Support
 


1. Execute campaign tracking (UTMs), nurture flow builds, and sequence design per Marketing/Sales requirements.
2. Assist with waterfall enrichment logic and match\-rate troubleshooting in coordination with data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
3. Support first\-touch/last\-touch attribution reporting and funnel conversion tracking.



 Reporting \& Analytics
 


1. Build standard HubSpot reports and dashboards tracking pipeline, campaign performance, and activity metrics.
2. Flag data\-quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, broken syncs) to the Business CRM Analyst or RevOps Lead promptly.



 Delivery Process (Contributor per DACI)
 


1. Configure/build each assigned story in HubSpot against acceptance criteria set by the Business CRM Analyst.
2. Complete the Self\-QA Checklist — functional test, data validation, regression check, access/permissions check, evidence attached — before moving a story to Ready for UAT.
3. Give the standing Delivery \& Build Update on weekly client calls: what was configured, what passed Self\-QA, what's blocked.
4. Escalate directly and promptly to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief or needing core technical guidance — an ad hoc coaching step, not a formal workflow stage.



 Data Governance \& Quality
 


1. Follow the deduplication, normalization, and data hygiene standards set for the account.
2. Maintain clean documentation and evidence trails on every ticket per the Self\-QA standard.



 Required Qualifications
 


1. 4\+ years of hands\-on RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, or CRM Admin experience, with solid working expertise in HubSpot (Sales Hub and Marketing Hub required; exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, or CMS Hub is a strong plus).
2. Comfortable independently building workflows, sequences, lead scoring, and reporting on well\-scoped tickets.
3. Basic familiarity with Salesforce or another secondary CRM (Zoho) is a plus.
4. Exposure to GTM data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit) is helpful but not required.
5. Comfort working in a Jira/DACI\-based delivery model — clear on when to build independently versus when to escalate.
6. Solid communication skills; comfortable giving a live build update on client calls.



 Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications
 


1. HubSpot certifications (Sales Hub Implementation, Marketing Hub Implementation, or RevOps).
2. Experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
3. Exposure to Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, or Segment.
4. Basic reporting/BI tool familiarity (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).



 Success Metrics / What Good Looks Like in the First 90 Days
 


1. Completes assigned stories with Self\-QA evidence passing UAT on first review most of the time.
2. Comfortable running the Delivery \& Build Update on weekly client calls without the Lead needing to be present.
3. Has used the ad hoc escalation path to the RevOps Lead at least once, resolving a technical blocker without it becoming a client\-facing risk.
4. Shows growing independence on a second HubSpot hub beyond the core Sales/Marketing scope.



 Soft Skills / Competencies
 


1. Detail\-oriented executor: follows acceptance criteria and QA standards precisely.
2. Proactive communicator: flags blockers early rather than at UAT.
3. Growth mindset: actively building toward multi\-hub HubSpot depth.
4. Reliable ownership of assigned tickets from build through clean handoff.



 Compensation \& Benefits
 


1. A clear path to Sr. RevOps HubSpot Specialist and, eventually, RevOps Lead.
2. Structured mentorship from a RevOps Lead and technical exposure across varied clients.
3. Collaborative, high\-performing RevOps delivery team.



  





 This role is for builders growing their HubSpot depth!
 



*If you're hands\-on with HubSpot and want to grow into full\-suite RevOps ownership — not just ticket execution — we want to hear from you.* 




  





 Know more about us at https://york.ie/

description:
**About Business**

 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

 AEL Corporate Services plays a pivotal role in managing essential corporate functions such as finance, insurance, and secretarial services at a group level for all Adani business units. By centralizing these critical operations, AEL CS ensures efficiency, standardization, and strategic alignment across the conglomerate. Its expertise in risk management, governance, and financial stewardship supports the Group's dynamic growth while maintaining compliance with global standards. Through innovation and a commitment to excellence, AEL CS underpins the Adani Group’s vision of sustainable value creation and nation\-building. 
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 This role is responsible for leading the company's insurance activities, ensuring comprehensive coverage for the group’s assets, new acquisitions, and projects. This role includes overseeing the insurance renewal process, preparing detailed Request for Proposals (RFPs), handling claims, managing relationships with local insurers and reinsurers, and ensuring compliance with insurance policies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Risk Transfer Strategy Execution \& Insurance Management**
* Lead the assessment of emerging global risks, including climate\-related, cyber, and geopolitical risks, to ensure the group’s insurance portfolio remains adaptive.
* Support the Group Head in the reinsurance procurement process for high\-value and complex risks, collaborating with reinsurers to secure optimal coverage for emerging risks.
* Lead the insurance needs analysis for new assets, acquisitions, and business ventures by coordinating with business units and technical teams to assess operational risks.
* Ensure proper coverage for all new acquisitions and ventures by engaging with local insurers and reinsurers.
* Ensure timely endorsements for new assets or additional coverage needs, minimizing exposure to risk by guaranteeing that insurance is in place before assets become operational.


**Comprehensive Insurance Renewal**
* Lead the annual insurance renewal process for all assets and liabilities, ensuring that insurance terms are reviewed and adjusted based on changes in asset values and risk profiles.
* Collaborate with the CFO (Chief Financial Officer) and Financial Controller to ensure approval of the renewal strategy before proceeding to market, and maintain constant communication to update them on any changes.
* Engage with the market to obtain competitive renewal terms, negotiating directly with insurers and reinsurers to achieve the best possible premium rates and coverage conditions.


**Request for Proposals (RFPs) Management**
* Manage the preparation and issuance of Request for Proposals (RFPs) for various types of insurance, ensuring clear communication of the group’s requirements to insurers.
* Lead the creation of NFAs (Notes for Approval) to ensure adherence with corporate governance standards.


**Claims Management \& Settlements**
* Lead the claims management process, ensuring efficient assessment, documentation, and settlement in compliance with policy terms.
* Collaborate with third\-party adjusters and surveyors to ensure accurate claims evaluation and timely settlement.
* Lead the development of data analytics framework for forecasting claims trends, improving decision\-making, and reducing the risk of future claims.
* Lead the digitization of policy and claims documentation, ensuring all records are easily accessible and stored in a central repository.


**Market Relations**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with local and global insurers, reinsurers, and InsurTech companies to secure competitive quotes and favourable terms.
* Negotiate with insurance brokers to ensure alignment between the group’s risk profile and available coverage.
* Actively engage with facultative reinsurers when necessary, securing reinsurance policies either through direct outreach or intermediaries to cover high\-value or complex risks.


**Insurance Operations \& Process Standardization**
* Lead the execution of standardization of insurance processes across the organization, ensuring consistency in policy procurement, claims reporting, and documentation management.
* Supervise the development and integration of standardized insurance\-related forms, ensuring compliance and efficiency across business units.


**Negotiation and Finalization of Insurance Policies**
* Lead multi\-round negotiations with insurers to finalize terms for both new policies and renewals, focusing on achieving the best coverage limits, deductibles, and premiums.
* Ensure accurate communication of risk details and coverage to the insurers.


**Corporate Governance \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with insurance regulations, including SEBI, IRDAI, and regional standards, across the group’s insurance activities.
* Lead preparation of compliance reports, including insurance certifications and auditor reports for statutory filings.
* Work closely with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all insurance contracts align with corporate policies and regulatory standards.


**Risk Identification \& Business Interface**
* Lead identification of new and emerging risks across the group’s operations, ensuring effective mitigation strategies are implemented.
* Lead the establishment of a robust third\-party risk management framework, ensuring vendors, suppliers, and contractors working with the group are covered by appropriate liability insurance.
* Collaborate with business units to update the insurance portfolio, addressing changes in the risk landscape.


**Digitization and Automation**
* Lead the digitization of the insurance function, including the development of a centralized bid management system to streamline procurement and enhance operational efficiency.
* Drive automation of insurance\-related processes, including the development of a digital insurance management system to generate automated workflows for claims management, premium payments, and coverage renewals.
* Integrate AI\-driven tools for predictive risk modelling to optimize coverage, minimize premium costs, and improve operational efficiency.


**Cross\-Departmental Collaboration and Stakeholder Management**
* Align with the Group Head Insurance on market trends, pricing shifts, and underwriting criteria that could impact the group’s strategies.
* Collaborate with internal departments (finance, legal, technical) to ensure alignment between insurance requirements and business objectives.
* Liaise with the legal department to ensure policy interpretations are aligned with business interests.
* Manage the interface between business units and insurers, ensuring seamless communication regarding evolving insurance needs.


**People and Team Management**
* Ensure insurance team members are aligned with business strategy and insurance objectives, providing them with career development opportunities.
* Oversee team performance, supporting continuous development and departmental excellence in line with organizational goals.
* Cultivate an environment conducive to collaboration, enabling the team to thrive within the dynamic landscape of the energy sector.


**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
**Internal Stakeholders**
* CFO (Chief Financial Officer)
* Financial Controller
* Business Unit Heads
* Legal Team
* ABEX Team
* Technical Teams
* Senior Leadership


**External Stakeholders**
* Local Insurance Companies
* Reinsurers
* Insurance Brokers
* Surveyors and Loss Adjusters
* Facultative Reinsurance Providers


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
 B.E./ B.Tech., Additional MBA in Insurance or additional insurance qualifications preferred
   

  

**Experience**
 Minimum 14 \- 16 years of experience in corporate insurance, underwriting, or risk management roles, with significant experience in negotiating with insurers and reinsurers.
   

  

**Industry Preferred**
 Background in Power and Energy sector preferred with an understanding of both local and international insurance markets and the ability to engage with facultative reinsurers for complex risks.

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer - Product Development
description:
Immediate Hiring \| Joining Date: 1st October 2026 (or Earlier Preferred)
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Company: iNSPIRE Design
 



  





  





 Please Read Before Applying
 



 We are looking for a Lead Mechanical Engineer who can join on or before 1st September 2026\.
 



 If you are serving a notice period that extends beyond this date, please apply only if your current employer is willing to provide an early release.
 



 This is an immediate requirement, and applications from candidates who can join within the required timeline will be given preference.
 



  





  





 About iNSPIRE Design
 



 iNSPIRE Design is a product development and engineering company based in Ahmedabad. We work with startups, established companies, research institutions, and healthcare professionals to develop new products from early\-stage concepts through functional prototypes and manufacturing readiness.
 



 Our projects primarily involve medical devices, electromechanical products, test fixtures, consumer products, automation systems, and custom engineering solutions. The work is highly varied and requires strong first\-principles engineering, practical problem\-solving, rapid prototyping, and close coordination with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking for a senior, hands\-on mechanical engineer who can take technical ownership of complex product development projects.
 



 This is not a role limited to CAD modelling or preparing drawings. The selected candidate will be expected to understand client requirements, develop product architectures, make engineering decisions, guide junior engineers and designers, resolve prototype failures, and lead projects through design, testing, iteration, and manufacturing handover.
 



 The person should be capable of operating independently and gradually taking ownership of the day\-to\-
 



 day engineering function within the company.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





  





 Product Development and Engineering
 


* Lead mechanical product development projects from initial requirements through functional prototype and manufacturing readiness.
* Convert incomplete or evolving client requirements into clear engineering specifications and development plans.
* Develop product architecture, mechanisms, assemblies, enclosures, structural components, and electromechanical integration concepts.
* Perform engineering calculations related to loads, stresses, fits, tolerances, motion, thermal behaviour, material selection, and manufacturing feasibility.
* Identify technical risks early and develop practical methods to test and reduce those risks.
* Review existing designs critically and recommend improvements based on performance, reliability, cost, usability, and manufacturability.
* Troubleshoot prototype failures and lead structured root\-cause analysis and corrective action.



  





  





 Design and Documentation
 


* Create and review detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Apply appropriate GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, fits, clearances, fastener selection, and assembly considerations.
* Maintain proper revision control, design records, BOMs, technical specifications, and project documentation.
* Ensure designs are suitable for prototyping as well as eventual production.
* Conduct design reviews and approve engineering outputs before release.



  





  





 Prototyping and Testing
 


* Plan and supervise the fabrication and assembly of proof\-of\-concept and functional prototypes.
* Select suitable prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, laser cutting, casting, and off\-the\-shelf component integration.
* Develop test plans, fixtures, acceptance criteria, and validation methods.
* Personally participate in prototype assembly, testing, debugging, and design iteration where required.
* Make sound engineering decisions even when complete data or ideal resources are unavailable.



  





  





 Manufacturing and Vendor Coordination
 


* Work directly with machine shops, fabricators, moulders, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Review vendor quotations, manufacturing processes, tolerances, material specifications, and technical capabilities.
* Resolve manufacturing and assembly issues without compromising critical product requirements.
* Support design for manufacturing, design for assembly, cost reduction, and production handover activities.
* Evaluate whether components should be custom\-developed, modified, or sourced as standard parts.



  





  





 Technical Leadership
 


* Guide and review the work of mechanical engineers, industrial designers, interns, and prototyping staff.
* Break larger projects into clearly defined engineering tasks and assign them effectively.
* Establish practical design standards, review processes, calculation practices, and documentation systems.
* Coach junior team members while maintaining accountability for timelines and quality.
* Raise the overall technical capability and engineering discipline of the organisation.
* Take responsibility for technical decisions rather than depending on constant direction from the founder.



  





  





 Project and Client Ownership
 


* Participate in client discussions to understand technical requirements, constraints, and priorities.
* Explain engineering decisions, risks, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Prepare realistic project plans, resource estimates, development timelines, and technical deliverables.
* Track engineering progress and proactively address delays, dependencies, and technical blockers.
* Represent the company confidently during technical reviews, vendor discussions, and client meetings.
* Balance engineering quality with commercial realities, project budgets, and delivery commitments.



  





  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related discipline.
* Approximately 7–12 years of relevant experience in mechanical product development, machine design, medical devices, electromechanical products, automation, or a similar field.
* Strong hands\-on experience taking physical products from concept through prototyping and manufacturing.
* Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks or a comparable parametric CAD platform.
* Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, tolerances, GD\&T, and assembly methods.
* Demonstrated ability to perform engineering calculations and validate designs through testing.
* Experience working directly with vendors and resolving real\-world manufacturing problems.
* Experience leading projects or mentoring junior engineers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-moving, project\-driven environment.



  





  





 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience developing medical devices or healthcare\-related products.
* Experience with electromechanical systems involving motors, sensors, actuators, PCBs, wiring, batteries, heating systems, fluid systems, or embedded electronics.
* Familiarity with risk management, verification, validation, and regulated product development.
* Working knowledge of FEA, thermal analysis, tolerance analysis, and design optimisation.
* Experience with injection moulding, silicone moulding, sheet metal, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, project plans, cost estimates, and client presentations.
* Exposure to quality systems, ISO 13485, design controls, or medical device documentation would be an advantage.



  





  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 The right candidate will be:
 


* A strong engineer first and a manager second.
* Comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for the outcome.
* Highly practical and capable of turning concepts into working physical products.
* Willing to question assumptions and challenge technically weak approaches.
* Systematic when investigating failures and resolving engineering problems.
* Capable of balancing ideal engineering solutions with cost, timelines, available resources, and manufacturability.
* Comfortable working across multiple projects and industries.
* Able to communicate directly with clients and defend engineering decisions.
* Interested in building an engineering team and improving how product development is executed across the company.



  





  





 What This Role Is Not
 



 This is not a role for someone whose experience is limited to:
 


* Creating CAD models based on instructions provided by others.
* Managing teams without remaining technically hands\-on.
* Working only on one narrow component or process within a large organisation.
* Preparing presentations and reports without building and testing physical products.
* Waiting for complete requirements before beginning engineering work.



  





  





 Why Join iNSPIRE Design
 


* Work on diverse and technically challenging product development projects.
* Take meaningful ownership of products rather than working on isolated components.
* Work directly with founders, clients, researchers, doctors, startups, and manufacturing partners.
* Build prototypes and see designs progress from initial concepts to real physical products.
* Play a central role in developing the company’s engineering function.
* Opportunity to grow into broader engineering and technical leadership responsibilities as the organisation expands.



  





  





 Application Requirements
 



 Candidates should submit:
 


* An updated resume.
* A brief portfolio or examples of products, mechanisms, machines, or assemblies they have personally developed.
* A clear description of their individual contribution to each project.
* Details of one significant prototype or product failure they diagnosed and resolved.
* Current location, notice period, and availability for an on\-site role in Ahmedabad.

**Construction IT Systems**

* Collaborate with airport operations to provide operational support for critical 24/7 airport functions related to construction projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a liaison between the IT department and construction stakeholders to ensure technology meets project requirements and adheres to regulatory compliance.


**Risk Management \& Compliance**
* Identify potential IT risks related to construction projects and develop mitigation strategies.

* Address health and safety concerns by ensuring that IT systems are designed to support safe construction practices.


**Budget And Financial Oversight**
* Oversee the IT project budget specific to construction, ensuring cost\-effective use of resources and technology investments.
* Provide financial forecasts and reports on project IT expenditures to senior management.


**Vendor And Contract Management**
* Negotiate and manage relationships with IT vendors, ensuring the delivery of quality services and adherence to contractual obligations.
* Oversee the procurement of IT systems and services, ensuring alignment with the airport's long\-term technology roadmap.


**Digital Mindset**
* Drive the adoption of innovative digital technologies like BIM, IoT, and data analytics to enhance efficiency in construction projects.
* Stay updated with emerging construction technologies to improve efficiency and ensure airport infrastructure is built using advanced IT solutions.


**Team Leadership And Development**
* Lead and mentor team members by providing constructive feedback, helping them develop their technical and project management skills.
* Develop a pipeline of talent within the team to ensure continuity in IT projects.
* Actively engage the team by promoting a positive work culture and recognizing individual and collective achievements.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**

* Project Head
* IT Department Head
* Project Management Team
* IT Infrastructure Team
* Construction Engineers
* Techno Commercial \& Contracts Department
* Compliance \& Regulatory Department

* External Contractors and Subcontractors
* Government Regulatory Bodies
* IT Consultants
* Health and Safety Agencies
* External Auditors and Inspectors

**Educational Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology/Electronics/Instrumentation or a related field.

**Work Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience in IT project management, with specific experience in managing IT systems for large\-scale infrastructure or construction projects with minimum 5 years experience in airports.

title: Transformer Electrical & Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Company Profile:** 




  





 Electrotherm (India) Limited, founded in 1983, is a technology\-driven engineering company focused on innovation and customer\-centric product development. The company designs and manufactures high\-capacity furnaces, metal refining converters, ladle furnaces, and high\-speed continuous casting machines that enhance steel quality and productivity. Electrotherm also develops mechanized charging systems, advanced plant automation solutions, and fume capturing and de\-dusting systems to make steel plants cleaner and more efficient. Guided by the mission “Always innovate for a better tomorrow,” the organization emphasizes in\-house research and development and continuous improvement in its solutions for the steel and metals industry.
 



  





**Job Title: Transformer Electrical \& Mechanical Design Engineer.** 




  





**Industry: Transformer and Switch gear Manufacturing** 




**Department: Design** 




**Reports To: Design Head** 




**Experience: 5\+ Years** 




  





**Job Location: Ahmedabad** 




  





 A
 **Transformer Electrical \& Mechanical Design Engineer** 
 is responsible for designing power/distribution transformers so they meet customer specifications, applicable standards, manufacturing constraints, performance guarantees, and cost targets.
 



 Typical responsibilities include:
 



 ·      
 **Electrical design:** 
 calculate transformer rating, voltage/current levels, turns ratio, winding arrangement, conductor sizing, current density, flux density, core area, losses, impedance, efficiency, temperature rise, insulation levels, short\-circuit withstand, clearances, creepage distances, and dielectric performance.
 



 ·      
 **Winding design:** 
 select winding type such as layer, helical, disc, continuous\-disc, or foil; determine conductor dimensions, number of turns, radial/axial dimensions, cooling ducts, insulation thicknesses, and transposition requirements.
 



 ·      
 **Core design:** 
 select core material and grade, core diameter, step\-lap arrangement, limb/yoke dimensions, flux density, core weight, no\-load loss, and excitation current.
 



 ·      
 **Insulation coordination:** 
 design insulation for impulse, power\-frequency, induced\-voltage, and partial\-discharge requirements; determine barriers, cylinders, spacers, end insulation, lead clearances, and oil/solid insulation distances.
 



 ·      
 **Thermal design:** 
 evaluate winding and oil temperature rise, cooling ducts, heat dissipation, radiator requirements, and cooling systems such as ONAN, ONAF, OFAF, or OFWF.
 



 ·      
 **Short\-circuit and mechanical strength calculations:** 
 verify radial and axial electromagnetic forces and ensure windings, clamping systems, leads, and support structures can withstand fault conditions.
 



 ·      
 **Mechanical design:** 
 develop tank, cover, conservator, radiator, core\-frame, clamping, lifting, jacking, foundation, terminal arrangement, cable box, bus duct, and accessory layouts.
 



 ·      
 **Structural calculations:** 
 check tank strength, vacuum withstand, pressure withstand, lifting loads, transportation loads, seismic requirements where applicable, and mechanical stresses.
 



 ·      
 **Bushing and accessory selection:** 
 select HV/LV bushings, OLTC/DETC, CTs, PRD, Buchholz relay, oil level indicator, temperature indicators, marshalling box, valves, gauges, and other customer\-specified accessories.
 



 ·      
 **Drawings and documentation:** 
 prepare or review GA drawings, winding drawings, core\-coil assembly drawings, tank fabrication drawings, connection diagrams, BOMs, material specifications, nameplate details, and manufacturing documents.
 



 ·      
 **Standards compliance:** 
 ensure designs comply with applicable standards such as
 **IEC 60076, IEEE/ANSI C57, IS 2026** 
 , customer specifications, and internal engineering practices.
 



 ·      
 **Design verification:** 
 review guaranteed losses, impedance, noise, temperature rise, dielectric levels, dimensions, weights, oil quantity, transport limitations, and overall performance before design release.
 



 ·      
 **Manufacturing support:** 
 work with winding, core, assembly, tank fabrication, insulation, and production teams to resolve manufacturing issues and implement design improvements.
 



 ·      
 **Testing support:** 
 review routine, type, and special test results including ratio, resistance, losses, impedance, temperature\-rise, impulse, induced\-voltage, applied\-voltage, partial\-discharge, and sound\-level tests.
 



 ·      
 **Technical troubleshooting:** 
 investigate test failures, excessive losses, high temperature rise, abnormal impedance, dielectric failures, vibration, leakage, or mechanical problems and implement corrective actions.
 



 ·      
 **Customer and project support:** 
 review technical specifications, prepare clarification documents, attend design\-review meetings, respond to customer comments, and support tender/project engineering teams.
 



 ·      
 **Cost optimization:** 
 optimize conductor, core steel, insulation, oil, tank steel, radiators, and accessories without compromising reliability or guaranteed performance.
 



 ·      
 **Design tools:** 
 commonly use transformer\-design software together with AutoCAD/SolidWorks/Creo, Excel, 2D/3D CAD, FEA tools, thermal\-analysis tools, and ERP/PLM systems.
 



  





**Salary:** 
 No salary bar for right candidate
 



 Interested candidate can send their updated CV on
 **Jagdish.mali@electrotherm.com**

Job Description – Career Counsellor / Candidate Success Specialist (US Staffing)
 




  






 We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven Career Counsellor / Candidate Success Specialist to support U.S.\-based job seekers in securing full\-time opportunities across IT and Non\-IT domains. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of the U.S. job market, employment authorization categories, and candidate marketing strategies, with the ability to guide professionals through every stage of their job search journey.
 




**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct detailed candidate assessments to understand educational background, technical and functional skills, professional experience, visa status, career aspirations, and location preferences.
* Offer personalized career counseling and job search strategies tailored to each candidate’s profile, ensuring alignment with current market demands and hiring trends.
* Develop and execute profile marketing strategies by presenting candidates to suitable employers, recruiters, and hiring managers while considering visa\-related constraints and eligibility requirements.
* Assist candidates in identifying opportunities across diverse industries, including information Technology,Engineering,Healthcare,Finance,Operations,Customer Support, Administration, and other professional sectors.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of active candidates through continuous engagement, relationship management, referrals, networking,and proactive outreach initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with recruitment, account management, and business development teams to align candidate availability with client hiring needs and ensure timely submissions and placements.
* Track candidate activities, application progress, interview schedules, feedback, and placement status through CRM and recruitment management systems.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with candidates to provide constructive feedback, identify improvement areas, address challenges, and maintain high engagement levels throughout the hiring process.
* Guide candidates on professional branding, including LinkedIn optimization, networking best practices, job portal utilization, and effective communication with recruiters and hiring managers.
* Stay informed about U.S. labor market trends, industry hiring demands, employment regulations, and visa\-related considerations to provide accurate and up\-to\-date career guidance.
* Support placement closures by coordinating interviews, managing offer discussions, ensuring documentation readiness, and facilitating smooth onboarding processes.



  
 



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing, Psychology, or a related field.
* Experience in Career Counseling, US Staffing, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Candidate Relationship Management.
* Strong understanding of U.S. visa categories and employment authorization processes, including OPT, STEM OPT, H1B, H4 EAD, and Green Card status considerations.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, counselling, and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong resume review, interview coaching, and candidate mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple candidates and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with ATS, CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and recruitment tools.
* Results\-oriented mindset with a focus on candidate success, placements, and client satisfaction.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Candidate placement and closure rate.
* Interview\-to\-offer conversion ratio.
* Candidate engagement and retention metrics.
* Resume optimization and profile marketing success rate.
* Candidate satisfaction and feedback scores.
* Timely follow\-up and pipeline management effectiveness.




 This role is ideal for professionals passionate about helping candidates achieve their career goals while driving successful placements within the U.S. job market.

title: Senior Student Counsellor
description:
Manifest Global empowers in building companies that connect the world towards growth, prosperity, and innovation. Our portfolio includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, BridgeU, Explore, and Kaaiser, which are dedicated to expanding global student mobility by serving their respective stakeholders in the ecosystem.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 To create a world where every student, regardless of their ethnicity, nationality, socio\-economic status, and learning preference, gets equal access to higher education through our world\-class network of portfolio brands; a network that globally connects community stakeholders that provide the finest resources and support material, anywhere in the world and at any time.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Every year, tens of thousands of Indian students decide they want to study in Europe, and most of them are making that decision with almost nothing to go on. Unlike the well\-worn paths to the US, UK, or Australia, Europe's university systems, visa rules, and application timelines vary by country, and until recently there was no single place in India built specifically to make sense of it. Families take out loans, sell assets, or bet a year of a child's life on a decision they are navigating largely in the dark.
   

  

 EduGo Abroad exists to close that gap. As India's only platform dedicated specifically to European education, it has spent over fifteen years building the trust, the university relationships, and the process knowledge that a fragmented, agent\-by\-agent market never had. That trust is not abstract. It shows up as thousands of students who have already been placed, and thousands more currently mid\-decision, each one needing someone who can turn a confusing set of options into a clear, confident next step.
   

  

 This role sits at the point where that trust is either earned or lost. You are the person a student and their family actually talk to, week after week, from the first conversation about what's possible through to the day they get on a plane. Everything EduGo has built as a platform, network, and reputation runs through the quality of that conversation.
   

  

 At the highest level, this role owns the full counselling relationship with a portfolio of students, from first contact through to enrolment and visa outcome.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most study\-abroad counselling in India happens through agents who work by referral fee and volume, with limited real accountability for whether a student ends up in the right programme. EduGo counsellors work differently: you are backed by direct university partnerships, a dedicated European course database, and a platform built to remove friction rather than add it. You are not selling a generic "study abroad" dream. You are the specialist in one continent, which means you can go deeper, faster, and with more credibility than a generalist agent ever could.
   

  

 As part of Manifest Global, this role also sits inside a broader ecosystem of study\-abroad expertise: Kaaiser's decades of counselling experience in the India\-to\-Australia corridor, Cialfo's platform trust with schools, and the shared operating discipline of a group that has scaled this exact playbook before. No standalone European education agency in India has that depth behind it.
   

  

 The broader overseas education industry is contracting. EduGo is growing.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Student and parent counselling**
* Own the counselling relationship with an assigned portfolio of prospective students and their families
* Translate each student's academic background, budget, and ambitions into a realistic, well\-matched set of European university and course options
* Guide students through interview preparation and every stage of the admission process, from shortlist to offer


**Premium and high\-value accounts**
* Own a subset of premium student profiles with an elevated standard of responsiveness and personalisation
* Act as the single point of contact across the full application and admission journey, so no student is passed between people mid\-decision


**Pipeline and conversion**
* Drive each lead from first counselling conversation through application, conversion, and enrolment
* Identify where conversion is slipping in your own pipeline and adjust your approach — follow\-up cadence, objection handling, positioning — rather than waiting to be told
* Ensure every interaction, follow\-up, and outcome is logged accurately in the CRM


**Coordination and market knowledge**
* Coordinate with internal teams and university partners to keep applications, admissions, and enrolments moving without gaps
* Stay current on university requirements, visa guidelines, and course changes across your countries of focus, and flag anything that changes how a student should be advised


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where EduGo's counselling team is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In your first weeks, you are learning the European university landscape in enough depth to have a real conversation with a student — not reciting course names, but explaining why one path fits them better than another. You are also learning EduGo's process end to end, from first counselling call to visa outcome, so you know exactly where a student's application actually stands at any moment.
   

  

 By the middle of your first year, students in your portfolio are moving through the funnel with noticeably less friction. You've built a rhythm of follow\-up that doesn't feel like nagging, and families trust you enough to come back with hard questions instead of going quiet. Your CRM data is clean enough that anyone could pick up a case mid\-stream and understand where it stands.
   

  

 Over the longer term, you've built a reputation — with students, with parents, and internally — as someone whose portfolio simply performs, and whose judgment on a borderline case is trusted. The relationships you've built outlast any single admission cycle.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You've counselled students on study\-abroad decisions before, and you understand that this is rarely a purely rational purchase — it's a family decision with real financial and emotional weight behind it, and you know how to hold both the commercial and human sides of that conversation at once.
   

  

 You communicate with the kind of clarity and warmth that makes a nervous parent relax. You can explain a visa requirement or a course structure in plain language, and you're comfortable being direct when a student's expectations don't match reality, because you know that's more useful to them than false reassurance.
   

  

 You bring a positive, determined approach to a sales cycle that has real ups and downs — leads go quiet, plans change, deadlines slip — and you don't let that erode your consistency with the students still counting on you.
   

  

 You think critically rather than following a script. When something about a case doesn't add up — a mismatched course choice, an unrealistic timeline — you're the one who catches it before it becomes a problem.
   

  

 You're coachable. You stay current on an industry that changes constantly — new visa rules, new university requirements, new competitive dynamics — because you understand that what you knew last intake isn't automatically still true.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what EduGo is building and your first reaction was that this is exactly the kind of trust\-building work you want to be doing. That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early

 BetterBugs is hiring
 **Growth Marketer** 
  in Ahmedabad.
 



**Role:** 
 Growth Marketer 
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office (Ahmedabad)
 



**Shift:** 
 Regular
 



**Walk\-in Date** 

 : Friday \& Saturday – 25th \& 26th September 2026
 




  





  





**About BetterBugs** 




 BetterBugs.io is a browser\-based bug reporting and debugging platform built for QA and development teams. Our Chrome extension lets anyone capture screenshots, screen recordings, and "Rewind" clips of a bug in one click — with console logs, network requests, and environment data auto\-attached. Reports push straight into Jira, Linear, GitHub, Slack, and more, and our built\-in AI Debugger helps teams find root causes faster. We help software teams cut the back\-and\-forth between QA, support, and engineering — making bug reporting up to 10x faster.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Growth Marketer to own BetterBugs marketing end\-to\-end. This isn't an execution\-only role — you'll be responsible for outcomes across content, SEO, and social as one connected function, and for running growth experiments across the full funnel. You'll work across all of BetterBugs' core products and buyer types, so you'll need to move comfortably between technical and non\-technical audiences.
 



  





**What the Role Involves** 



* Owning BetterBugs marketing end\-to\-end — content, SEO, and social run as one integrated function rather than separate workstreams
* Driving growth experiments across the funnel, from top\-of\-funnel acquisition through activation and conversion
* Working across all three core products and buyer types — adapting messaging and channels for QA teams, engineering/dev teams, and product/support teams
* Identifying what's working through data, then doubling down — and killing what isn't
* Collaborating closely with sales (inbound/outbound BDM and SDR functions) on lead quality, messaging, and campaign feedback
* Representing BetterBugs' voice consistently across content, SEO\-driven pages, and social channels



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 3–5 years of experience owning marketing outcomes, not just executing on a brief — you've been accountable for growth numbers, not just deliverables
* Strong grounding across content, SEO, and social — comfortable running all three rather than specializing in just one
* Comfort operating in a technical, B2B SaaS environment, with the ability to translate technical product capabilities into compelling positioning
* A experimental mindset — able to design, run, and interpret growth experiments across the funnel
* Data\-driven approach to prioritization, with comfort using analytics to guide decisions



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* Prior experience marketing to developers, QA teams, or technical B2B buyers
* Experience with dev\-tools, SaaS, or product\-led growth (PLG) companies
* Familiarity with SEO/content tooling and growth experimentation frameworks



  





**What We Offer** 




  




* End\-to\-end ownership of marketing — real influence over strategy, not just execution
* Fast\-growing product with strong early traction (Product Hunt, active user base)



  





 📅 Walk\-in Date: Friday \& Saturday – 25th \& 26th September 2026
 



 ⏰ Time: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
 



 📍 Venue: BetterBugs, 402, Dwarkesh Business Hub, Opp. Visamo Society, Motera, Ahmedabad – 380005
 



  




* Please complete this registration form if you intend to attend the walk\-in drive.
* Registration link: https://forms.gle/BqgKD1MJTjhDGHeP9

title: Advertising Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 StarAdwise is a digital marketing agency focused on helping brands grow through data\-driven strategies and measurable performance. The team specializes in performance marketing, SEO, content strategy, branding, and social media management to strengthen clients’ digital presence. By understanding each client’s unique business needs, StarAdwise designs tailored campaigns that effectively reach and engage target audiences. The agency is committed to maximizing ROI, improving online visibility, and crafting compelling brand narratives. StarAdwise values collaboration and long\-term partnerships to help organizations achieve their digital growth goals.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Advertising Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital advertising campaigns across channels such as search, social media, and display. Day\-to\-day tasks include setting up campaigns, managing budgets, monitoring performance metrics, and adjusting strategies to improve ROI and conversion rates. The Advertising Specialist will collaborate with marketing, content, and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives and messaging aligned with brand objectives. Additional responsibilities include preparing campaign reports, presenting insights to stakeholders, and staying current with industry trends and platform updates.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Data Analysis capabilities to evaluate campaign performance and optimize results.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and present advertising plans and results clearly.
* Candidates should possess Marketing expertise, including knowledge of digital advertising platforms, audience targeting, and campaign strategy.
* Candidates should possess Sales and conversion\-focused skills to design campaigns that drive leads, revenue, and measurable outcomes.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field are beneficial.
* Experience with tools like Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and other reporting platforms is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple campaigns simultaneously, and meet deadlines is preferred.

title: PPC Executive
description:
PPC Executive

 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a results\-driven PPC Executive with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in managing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns, preferably within the IT Services industry.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, campaign optimization, keyword research, conversion tracking, and performance analysis. The candidate will be responsible for driving high\-quality leads and maximizing ROI through data\-driven paid marketing strategies.

 Plan, create, execute, and manage PPC and paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms.
 



 Develop PPC strategies aligned with business objectives and lead\-generation targets.
 



 Conduct detailed keyword research, competitor analysis, audience research, and campaign planning.
 



 Create and optimize Search, Display, Remarketing, Performance Max, and other relevant Google Ads campaigns.
 



 Develop effective ad copies, headlines, descriptions, extensions, and audience targeting strategies.
 



 Manage campaign budgets and ensure efficient utilization of advertising spend.
 



 Monitor and optimize key performance metrics including CPC, CTR, CPA, CPL, conversions, conversion rate, and ROI.
 



 Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, lead quality, and conversion rates.
 



 Set up and monitor conversion tracking, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and other tracking tools.
 



 Analyze campaign data and prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights.

 Work closely with the Business Development, Sales, Content, Design, and Development teams to improve lead generation and conversion.
 



 Coordinate with the content and design teams for campaign creatives, landing pages, banners, and ad copies.
 



 Stay updated with the latest Google Ads updates, PPC trends, algorithm changes, tools, and industry best practices.
 



 Monitor competitors and identify new paid marketing opportunities for the IT Services business.
 



 Ensure campaigns comply with platform policies and maintain strong account health.
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in PPC / Performance Marketing.
 



 Experience working in the IT Services / IT Software industry is mandatory or highly preferred.
 



 Strong hands\-on experience with Google Ads and paid lead\-generation campaigns.
 



 Experience with Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram) and LinkedIn Ads.
 



 Strong knowledge of Google Search Ads, Display Ads, Performance Max, Remarketing, and Lead Generation campaigns.
 



 Excellent understanding of keyword research, match types, negative keywords, bidding strategies, audience targeting, and campaign optimization.
 



 Experience with Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.
 



 Good understanding of landing page optimization and conversion rate optimization.
 



 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach.
 



 Ability to manage multiple campaigns and budgets simultaneously.
 



 Good written and verbal communication skills.
 



 Preferred Industry Experience
 



  





 Candidates with experience handling PPC campaigns for IT Services, including:
 



  





 Web Development
 



 Mobile App Development
 



 Software Development
 



 Game Development
 



 E\-commerce Development
 



 SaaS / Software Products
 



 UI/UX \& Design Services
 



 Digital Transformation Services
 



 IT Consulting Services
 



  





 will be preferred.
