title: Management Trainee Program
description:
This is not your typical internship.
 
  





 Most internships teach you a function. This program is designed to teach you something bigger — how businesses actually grow. MeDigit is selecting 3 ambitious college students / freshers to join the MeDigit Business Growth Program as Business Growth Operators. You’ll work alongside the MeDigit team on live businesses, real growth challenges and actual outcomes. The idea is simple: instead of learning marketing through theory or dummy projects, you learn by being part of real business growth.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Management Trainee Program at MeDigit Advertising Private Limited is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. The trainee will support day\-to\-day program coordination, assist in planning and executing client\-focused initiatives, and help monitor progress against revenue and demand generation goals. Responsibilities include analyzing campaign data, preparing reports, participating in internal training sessions, and shadowing senior team members across functions such as client servicing, digital strategy, and operations. The role also involves communicating with internal stakeholders, contributing to process improvements, and learning to manage small projects under supervision.
 



  





**Opportunity:** 
 Internship / Management Trainee Program
 



**Openings:** 
 Only 3
   





 What will you do?
 
* Work on live brands and understand their real business challenges.
* Participate in actual growth projects involving advertising, content, social media and other digital channels.
* Contribute ideas, help execute them and see how they perform in the real world.
* Learn how marketing decisions connect to customers, conversions and business growth.


 What will you walk away with?
 
 You’ll leave with real\-world business exposure, practical digital skills, sharper business thinking and actual work you can talk about in future interviews.
 



 More importantly, you’ll start understanding marketing not simply as ads, posts or content — but as a tool for growing a business.
   




 Who are we looking for?
 
 You don't need to already be a digital marketing expert.
 



 We're looking for someone who is:
 


* Curious about businesses, brands and why some grow faster than others
* Comfortable learning by doing
* Full of ideas, but equally willing to execute
* Proactive, responsible and willing to figure things out
* Interested in building serious real\-world skills early in their career



 Students from
 **marketing, management, commerce, communications or related backgrounds** 
 are welcome — but your attitude and curiosity matter more than your degree.

description:
𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 – 𝗨𝗦 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 \& 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗚𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗦𝗘𝗢
 



  





 📍 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 🏢 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲: On\-Site
 



 💼 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲: 3\+ Years
 



 🕐 𝗘𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: Full\-Time
 



  





 𝗪𝗲’𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗮𝗻 𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝘄𝗵𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝘆𝗼𝗻𝗱 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀.
 



  





 We’re a growing startup with a technically strong team, working on 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱\-𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘀 𝘁𝗮𝗿𝗴𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗨𝗦 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁.
 



  





 Our focus isn't simply to increase organic traffic or push a few keywords up Google.
 



  





 The real objective is simple:
 



  





 𝗧𝘂𝗿𝗻 𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗼 𝗮 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘀.
 



  





 And that's where things get interesting.
 



  





 We work on SEO strategies across 𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝟱𝟬 𝗨𝗦 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗷𝗼𝗿 𝗰𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀, particularly for emergency and high\-intent service businesses. This involves a combination of 𝘁𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗼𝗻\-𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗼𝗳𝗳\-𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆, 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰/𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀, 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻.
 



  





 We're looking for someone with 𝟯\+ 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘀\-𝗼𝗻 𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 who enjoys figuring out \*why\* something works, testing new approaches, and building strategies rather than simply following an SEO checklist.
 



  





 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗯𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗼𝗻
 



  





 \* Developing and executing SEO strategies for US\-based lead\-generation websites
 



 \* Planning and implementing On\-Page, Off\-Page, Technical and Local SEO
 



 \* Building and scaling local SEO strategies across US states, cities and service areas
 



 \* Keyword research based on search intent, competition and commercial value
 



 \* Optimizing website architecture, internal linking and topical relevance
 



 \* Conducting technical SEO audits and resolving crawling, indexing and structural issues
 



 \* Working with sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, schema, redirects and other technical SEO elements
 



 \* Developing strategies for Google Maps / Local Pack and local organic visibility
 



 \* Building and executing quality\-focused backlink and authority\-building strategies
 



 \* Identifying content gaps and opportunities to build topical authority
 



 \* Analyzing Google Search Console, Google Analytics and SEO tool data
 



 \* Monitoring rankings, organic traffic and, most importantly, conversions/leads
 



 \* Experimenting with new SEO techniques and strategies
 



 \* Working closely with our content, development and marketing teams
 



 \* Using automation and AI tools where they can genuinely improve SEO workflows and efficiency
 



  





 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿
 



  





 \* 3\+ years of practical SEO experience
 



 \* Strong understanding of On\-Page, Off\-Page, Technical and Local SEO
 



 \* Experience with SEO for competitive markets
 



 \* Strong understanding of keyword research and search intent
 



 \* Ability to perform and interpret technical SEO audits
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush or equivalent
 



 \* Good understanding of internal linking, topical authority and site architecture
 



 \* Experience with Local SEO and location\-based search strategies
 



 \* Ability to analyze data and turn it into actionable SEO decisions
 



 \* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
 



 \* Good communication and documentation skills
 



 \* Most importantly, curiosity and a willingness to experiment
 



  





 𝗜𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗯𝗲 𝗮 𝗽𝗹𝘂𝘀 𝗶𝗳 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲
 



  





 \* Experience with US SEO
 



 \* Experience working with emergency\-service or other high\-intent local businesses
 



 \* Experience managing SEO across multiple locations
 



 \* Experience with Google Business Profiles and Local Pack optimization
 



 \* Experience with programmatic/local landing page strategies
 



 \* Experience with large websites or websites targeting hundreds of locations
 



 \* Knowledge of structured data/schema
 



 \* Experience with SEO automation, AI\-assisted workflows or tools such as n8n
 



 \* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript from an SEO perspective
 



  





 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁?
 



  





 We're a startup, so we're not looking for someone whose job is to:
 



  





 “Find keywords → write blogs → build some backlinks → send a monthly report.”
 



  





 Our approach is much more experimental.
 



  





 You'll be working alongside a technically strong team where SEO, development, content, data and automation come together.
 



  





 You'll have the opportunity to test ideas, analyze results, build new processes and contribute to strategies that can be deployed across multiple US markets at scale.
 



  





 If you enjoy SEO because you genuinely like figuring things out, rather than just following a predefined SOP, you'll probably enjoy working with us.
 



  





 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻 𝘄𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿
 



  





 You don't need to know every SEO technique in existence.
 



  





 But you should be someone who:
 



  





 Questions → Researches → Tests → Measures → Learns → Improves.
 



  





 We value people who can look at a website and say:
 



  





 \> “I think this is the problem. Here's what I'd test, here's why, and here's how we'll measure whether it worked.”
 



  





 📍 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗶𝘀 𝗮𝗻 𝗢𝗻\-𝗦𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝗻 𝗔𝗵𝗺𝗲𝗱𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗱

title: Brand Manager (Real Estate)

 Saanvi Nirman is a real estate developer focused on enriching lives through high\-quality, opulent living experiences, built on reliability, responsibility, and professionalism. Over the past nine years, the company has delivered approximately 1\.2 million square feet of construction, demonstrating steady growth and execution capability. Initially recognized for high\-end residential projects, Saanvi Nirman has expanded into commercial spaces and affordable mid\-income apartments. The organization continues to strengthen its presence across these segments, offering opportunities for professionals to contribute to a diverse portfolio of real estate developments.
 



  





**Ideal profile:** 

 marketing/brand management experience with agency handling exposure, strong understanding of real estate as an industry, strong project management and budget tracking skills, sharp eye for creative quality, comfortable holding external partners accountable to deadlines and standards.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Brand Manager role based in Ahmedabad. The Brand Manager will oversee brand positioning and messaging for Saanvi Nirman’s residential and commercial projects, ensuring consistency across all marketing and communication channels. Daily responsibilities include developing and executing brand strategies, coordinating campaign plans, and managing digital and offline marketing initiatives. The role involves collaborating with sales, design, and project teams to create compelling project stories, marketing collateral, and promotional materials. The Brand Manager will also track brand performance metrics, analyze market trends and customer insights, and recommend improvements to enhance brand visibility and equity in the real estate market.
 



  





  





 ● Own the relationship with the marketing/branding agency briefs, timelines, deliverables, and quality of output

title: Paid Ads & Performance Lead
description:
**Job Description:** 




  





 Build Campaigns That Generate Real Business Growth.
 



  





 Software Co is an Australian AI\-native software, product and venture studio. We design, build and scale custom software, AI platforms and digital ventures for ambitious startups, scale\-ups and established organisations.
 



  





 Alongside Software Co, our growing digital and creative agency helps businesses build their brands, generate demand and accelerate growth through high\-performance digital marketing.
 



 We are looking for an exceptional Paid Media \& Performance Lead. Someone who combines deep technical capability, commercial thinking and hands\-on campaign execution with a demonstrated ability to generate measurable business results.
 



  





 This is not an entry\-level digital marketing role, and it is not a position for someone whose experience has primarily involved coordinating agencies or reviewing campaign reports.
 



 We are looking for a genuine performance marketing operator who knows how to get inside an advertising account, understand what is happening, identify opportunities, build campaigns, solve tracking and conversion problems, test aggressively and continuously improve results.You should understand the difference between generating traffic and generating revenue.Success in this role will ultimately be measured by the quality and commercial value of the opportunities you generate and not impressions, clicks or vanity metrics.
 



  





**Key Skills and experience:** 




  





 You will take hands\-on responsibility for the strategy, execution, optimisation and performance of paid acquisition campaigns across Software Co, our portfolio of technology ventures and selected Rockatoo clients.
 



  




* Your responsibilities will include:Developing and executing sophisticated paid acquisition strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.
* Planning, building and optimising Google Search, Performance Max, Display, Remarketing and YouTube campaigns.
* Building and scaling high\-performing Meta campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Generating qualified B2B leads and sales opportunities for software development, AI, SaaS and technology\-related services.
* Managing significant advertising budgets with disciplined commercial and ROI accountability.
* Understanding the economics behind each campaign, including CPL, CPA, CAC, conversion rate, ROAS, pipeline generated and revenue contribution.
* Conducting continuous experimentation across audiences, keywords, bidding strategies, offers, messaging, creative, landing pages and conversion funnels.
* Performing detailed keyword, search\-intent, audience and competitor analysis.
* Identifying why campaigns are underperforming and systematically solving the underlying problem.
* Designing and improving acquisition funnels from first impression through to enquiry, qualification and conversion.
* Working closely with designers and content teams to develop advertising creative based on performance data and structured testing.
* Collaborating with sales teams to understand lead quality, not simply lead volume, and feeding this intelligence back into campaign optimisation.
* Establishing accurate conversion tracking and attribution across advertising platforms, websites, landing pages and CRM systems.
* Developing dashboards and reporting that clearly communicate performance, insights, opportunities and next actions.
* Staying at the forefront of Google's and Meta's evolving advertising platforms, automation capabilities, AI tools and emerging performance\-marketing practices.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 We want someone who can personally get into the detail.
 



  




* You should be highly competent across:Google Ads
* Meta Ads Manager
* LinkedIn Ads
* Google Analytics 4
* Google Tag Manager
* Conversion and event tracking
* Pixels and server\-side/conversion APIs
* UTM and campaign attribution
* Landing\-page optimisation
* Conversion\-rate optimisation
* Audience segmentation and remarketing
* CRM attribution and lead\-source tracking
* Performance reporting and analytics



  





 You should be comfortable diagnosing tracking discrepancies, understanding attribution problems and determining what is actually generating commercial outcomes.
 



 What We're Looking For
 



  





 We care significantly more about what you have achieved than what certifications you hold.
 


* Ideally, you will have:5\+ years of serious hands\-on experience managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns.
* Deep practical expertise across both Google Ads, Meta Ads \& LinkedIn Ads.
* A demonstrable history of generating measurable ROI from paid acquisition.
* Strong experience with B2B lead generation, particularly where customer acquisition involves higher\-value or longer sales cycles.
* Experience personally managing substantial advertising budgets.
* Strong knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking and attribution.
* Experience building and optimising landing pages and conversion funnels.
* Strong analytical capability and confidence working with campaign and commercial data.
* An understanding of the relationship between marketing spend, qualified pipeline, customer acquisition cost and revenue.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to clearly explain what is working, what isn't, why, and what should happen next.
* A strong bias toward action, experimentation and continuous improvement.



  





 Most importantly, you should be able to show us real campaigns and real results.
 



  





 Highly Desirable
 


* Experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:Software development or technology services marketing.
* SaaS and subscription businesses.
* AI products and platforms.
* High\-value B2B lead generation.
* LinkedIn Ads.
* HubSpot, Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
* Marketing automation and lead\-nurturing systems.
* Server\-side tracking and Conversion APIs.
* Call and offline conversion tracking.
* AI\-assisted campaign analysis, creative development and optimisation.
* Conversion\-rate optimisation and landing\-page experimentation.
* Multi\-brand or agency environments.



  





 The Person Who Will Thrive Here
 



  





 You are technical, tactical and commercially driven.
 



 You don't wait for someone else to tell you why a campaign isn't working. You investigate it.You don't accept a falling conversion rate as something to put into next week's report. You want to understand why it happened and what can be changed today.
 


* You are:Highly analytical and data\-driven.
* Commercially minded.
* Intensely curious.
* Technically capable.
* Hands\-on and execution\-focused.
* Comfortable taking ownership.
* Naturally experimental.
* Detail\-oriented without losing sight of the commercial objective.
* Comfortable being accountable for measurable outcomes.
* Constantly looking for the next optimisation opportunity.



  





 You understand that great performance marketing comes from hundreds of intelligent decisions and experiments compounded over time.
 



 And when something works, your instinct is to ask How do we scale it?
 



  





  





 Why Join Us?
 



 This is an opportunity to work across an unusually diverse portfolio of technology, AI and digital businesses.
 


* You will have the opportunity to:Work alongside an ambitious Australian AI\-native software and technology company.
* Help grow Software Co's own customer\-acquisition engine.
* Work across innovative software, SaaS and AI products spanning multiple industries.
* Build and scale campaigns through Rockatoo for a growing portfolio of clients.
* Work with modern advertising, analytics, automation and AI technology.
* Have significant autonomy over campaign strategy and execution.
* Test ideas quickly without unnecessary layers of bureaucracy.
* Work directly with marketing, creative, technology and sales teams.
* Take genuine ownership of performance.
* Earn competitive remuneration with performance incentives for exceptional results.
* Grow into a broader leadership position as our performance marketing capability expands.



  





 How to ApplyWe don't want a generic application telling us that you're "passionate about digital marketing."
 



 Show us what you've done.
 


* Along with your resume, please provide examples of campaigns you have personally managed and optimised, including wherever possible:Monthly advertising spend.
* Industry and target audience.
* CPL and CPA.
* Conversion rates.
* ROAS or revenue generated.
* Lead volumes and lead quality.
* Improvements you personally achieved.
* What wasn't working when you inherited or launched the campaign.
* What you changed.
* What happened as a result.



  





 Case studies, screenshots, dashboards or portfolio examples are strongly encouraged where confidentiality permits.
 



 During the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates should also be prepared to walk us through a real campaign, explain their thinking and demonstrate how they approach campaign analysis and optimisation.
 



 Immediate Start Available
 



 If you're the kind of performance marketer who gets excited about opening an advertising account, finding opportunities others have missed and turning advertising spend into measurable business growth, we want to speak with you.

title: IT Executive (Website & Email Management, IT Operations)
description:
We are hiring: IT Executive (Website \& Email Management, IT Operations)
 



 Worth Minds \| Ahmedabad \| Work from office \| Full\-time
 



 ₹18,000–₹25,000 per month \| 1–3 years of experience
 



  





 Keep our websites running, our email reliable and our team connected.
 



 Join Worth Minds and take ownership of its Laravel editorial platform and INOBAL’s PHP website through their admin panels, alongside social media content creation and publishing, our email infrastructure and everyday office IT. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems and following them through to completion.
 



  





 ABOUT WORTH MINDS
 



 Worth Minds is INOBAL’s editorial platform. Based in Ahmedabad, this role supports the platform’s publishing operations, email infrastructure and everyday IT, alongside INOBAL and client website projects. INOBAL works with founders, executives and organisations across the US, UK, Europe, Africa and India.
 



  





 WEBSITE \& ADMIN PANEL MANAGEMENT
 



 • Manage the admin panels of INOBAL (PHP) and Worth Minds (Laravel), including content, categories, menus, profiles and user permissions.
 



 • Build and publish pages, landing pages, articles, images, videos and features using available admin tools; check structure, styling, links and mobile display.
 



 • Coordinate with marketing and editorial teams on updates, and with developers on code changes, new features and complex issues.
 



 • Monitor uptime, page speed, Core Web Vitals and errors; maintain backups, SSL renewals, malware checks and website security.
 



 • Manage hosting panels, domains, subdomains, DNS and staging environments.
 



 • Maintain on\-page SEO, including titles, descriptions, alt text, URLs, sitemaps and schema where supported.
 



 • Maintain forms, popups, chat widgets and lead capture flows; manage Google Analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager and tracking pixels.
 



 • Support client website builds, redesigns, migrations and maintenance; share reports on traffic, speed, errors and uptime.
 



  





 EMAIL MANAGEMENT \& DELIVERABILITY
 



 • Create, configure and manage business email accounts across Google Workspace and other providers.
 



 • Set up and maintain SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for company and campaign domains.
 



 • Coordinate domain purchases and configure new outreach domains and mailboxes, including sending setup and warm\-up.
 



 • Monitor inbox placement, sender reputation, bounce rates and blocklist status; troubleshoot deliverability issues.
 



 • Manage sales outreach platforms and email sending infrastructure.
 



 • Set up signatures, aliases, forwarding, distribution groups and shared mailboxes.
 



 • Handle mailbox storage, archiving, recovery and employee offboarding.
 



 • Maintain spam filtering, phishing protection and access controls, with clear records of domains, mailboxes and DNS settings.
 



  





 IT OPERATIONS
 



 • Provide first\-level support for hardware, software, networks and account access.
 



 • Configure new joiner laptops, software and accounts; administer Google Workspace users, permissions, storage and security settings.
 



 • Maintain the IT asset register, licences, subscriptions and renewal calendar.
 



 • Coordinate internet, routers, printers, CCTV and office infrastructure with vendors.
 



 • Maintain backup routines and cybersecurity practices; work with hosting providers, registrars, software vendors and AMC partners.
 



  





 SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATION \& PUBLISHING
 



 • Create social media posts, carousels, banners, stories and basic short videos or reels for Worth Minds, INOBAL and assigned client projects.
 



 • Turn articles, interviews and brand updates into engaging captions, visuals and short\-form content, working from marketing and editorial briefs.
 



 • Upload, schedule and publish approved content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other assigned channels.
 



 • Maintain a content calendar and coordinate drafts, approvals and publishing deadlines with the team.
 



 • Adapt formats for each platform; check captions, spelling, links, tags, hashtags, thumbnails and brand consistency before posting.
 



 • Use Canva or similar tools for creatives and basic video editing, including trimming, subtitles and resizing.
 



 • Monitor comments and messages, route enquiries to the right team and flag issues that need attention.
 



 • Track reach, engagement, clicks and follower growth; share simple reports and suggest content improvements.
 



 • Keep social media profiles, bios, links and asset folders updated, and manage account access securely.
 



  





 DIGITAL SUPPORT
 



 • Support marketing with landing pages, email templates, integrations and automation.
 



 • Administer CRM, project management, outreach and AI tools; build simple workflows that reduce manual work.
 



 • Prepare basic banners and web graphics when required.
 



 • Document processes and system information securely, and support additional IT and digital operations as the business grows.
 



  





 WHAT YOU BRING
 



 • 1–3 years of experience in website management, email administration or IT support.
 



 • Confidence with website admin panels and content publishing, plus a working understanding of PHP and Laravel websites.
 



 • Working knowledge of DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and business email troubleshooting.
 



 • Basic HTML and CSS, with an understanding of JavaScript.
 



 • Familiarity with cPanel or Plesk, FTP, databases, website security, caching and speed optimisation.
 



 • Experience with Google Workspace administration.
 



 • Ability to create basic social media graphics, write clear captions and upload or schedule content; familiarity with Canva and basic video editing.
 



 • A degree in IT, Computer Science, BCA, MCA or an equivalent field.
 



 • Good English communication, organised documentation and ownership of requests from multiple teams.
 



  





 NICE TO HAVE
 



 • Experience with cold email or outreach infrastructure.
 



 • WordPress, Elementor and plugin management experience for relevant client projects.
 



 • Photoshop, social media scheduling tools and practical use of AI tools.
 



  





 YOUR GROWTH
 



 Gain exposure to every part of the business, with a path towards Digital Operations Specialist and senior IT positions as our web, email and client work expands.
 



  





 APPLY NOW
 



 Email your CV and links to websites you have built or managed to career@inobal.com.
 



 Subject: Application for IT Executive
 



 Include examples of social media posts, creatives or videos you have worked on, and briefly mention the admin panels, email platforms and technical responsibilities you have handled.
 



  





 Ahmedabad • Work from office • Full\-time
 



 ₹18,000–₹25,000 per month

The platform serves all key stakeholders in a society, including admins, management committee members, guards, and residents, and offers services from home maintenance to renting or selling property. * Comfort with on\-site work in Ahmedabad, flexible to work in rotational shifts and weekends as required.
* Graduate degree or equivalent; familiarity with community management, housing societies, or prop\-tech solutions is an advantage.

**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Business Excellence:** 
 Our Business Excellence Department drives operational transformation across Adani’s portfolio by integrating process optimization, digitalization, and best practices. Using cutting\-edge analytics and lean methodologies, we streamline operations to boost efficiency, quality, and sustainable growth. By fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaborating with internal teams and external partners, we implement strategic initiatives that maximize resource utilization and set new standards in operational excellence.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead is responsible for driving the adoption and execution of process assurance and operational excellence solutions across the organization. This role focuses on ensuring the business optimizes its processes and reduces inefficiencies through solutions like CWS, SPS, and BPR. The BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead will track performance metrics, standardize processes, and implement best practices that improve quality, compliance, and overall business performance. This role will work cross\-functionally to ensure that the organization is continuously improving, achieving operational goals, and reducing risks.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead**
**Process Improvement \& Digital Transformation**
 Lead continuous process improvement through Challenges Worth Solving (CWS), Structured Problem Solving (SPS), and BPR initiatives.
   

  

 Enhance automation, reduce manual errors, and improve operational efficiency by implementing digital transformation strategies.
   

  

 Streamline operations, reduce waste, and improve interdepartmental efficiency by leading cross\-functional projects.
   

  

**Performance Metrics \& Reporting**
 Ensure measurable improvements by defining and tracking performance metrics aligned with business objectives.
   

  

 Drive performance improvements and support business goals by implementing and regularly updating the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) for BUs.
   

  

**Process Governance \& Standardization**
 Improve process consistency and quality by developing and enforcing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
   

  

 Ensure compliance with ISO and quality standards, driving best practices in process governance.
   

  

**Training \& Capability Building**
 Enhance process knowledge and operational skills across teams by leading training initiatives.
   

  

 Support ongoing operational excellence by establishing the Adani Business Excellence Academy (ABEA) and a process assurance mechanism.
   

  

**Institutionalise The Adani Business Excellence Academy**
 Create a Virtual organisation Adani Business Excellence Academy which would be responsible for promoting the Business Excellence Roadmap across all BUs through ensuring focussed training \& development, monitoring of the Business Excellence activities \& their KPIs, promotion of BE roadmap through communication and appropriate R\&R
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Business Unit Heads (Energy, Ports, etc.)
   

  

 Adani Workforce Management System (AWMS)
   

  

 Adani Business Excellence Academy (ABEA)
   

  

 Operations Department
   

  

 Human Resources (HR) and Learning \& Development Department
   

  

 Finance Department
   

  

 Compliance Department
   

  

 Data Analytics Department
   

  

 Information Technology (IT) Department
   

  

 Senior Leadership (CXOs, CEO)
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Industry Benchmarking Bodies
   

  

 External Consultants and Partners
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Vendors and Technology Providers
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Conduct Business Excellence Maturity Assessments
* Liaise with Business Excellence Heads/ SPOCs in various BUs to conduct self\-assessment based on Business Excellence Maturity Assessment toolkit.
* Coordinate and organize the on\-site assessment of BUs which have undertaken self\-assessment through external assessment partner.
* Coordinate and facilitate the completion of BEx Maturity assessment report with external assessment partner
* Review the BEx Maturity assessment report and get it approved with senior BE leaders and handing over to the respective BU CEO
* Organization of action planning workshop in the respective BU through external assessment partner.
* Track and coordinate with respective BU BEx Heads to ensure timely closure of action items, drive them to logical conclusions, and monitor the realization of intended business benefits and impact.
* Identification, Capability building and certification of BU\-wise Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)
* Liaise with Business Excellence Heads/SPOCs in various BUs to identify Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in each of their key functions.
* Coordinate with external training partners and certification bodies to deliver capability\-building certification programs to develop and certify SMEs in alignment to their business needs.
* Manage end\-to\-end logistics, nominations, attendance, assessments, certifications, and program effectiveness reviews of these training programs.
* Review, monitor and track progress of improvement projects undertaken by training participants/SMEs, ensuring timely completion and benefit realization.
* Utilization of SMEs to undertake L\&D sessions for organization development
* Enable and guide SMEs to further conduct training and improvement initiatives within their businesses/functions, ensuring effective deployment of methodologies such as QC Tools, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and process Management, and monitoring the resulting business impact and benefits realization.
* Develop a strong network of such SMEs capable of independently conducting training and driving improvement initiatives within their functions and businesses.


**Qualifications**
**Skills and Educational Qualification:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Certification in Lean or Six Sigma methodologies is preferred
+ Certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt
+ Project \& Program management skills

title: Digital Growth Lead
description:
**We're hiring: Digital Growth Lead — Karma Ventures** 




  





 We're looking for one person to help build the digital growth engine across Karma.
 



 Karma Workspaces is part of the broader Karma Ventures group, and we're using our existing
 



 community to help us find the right person to join us.
 



 I'm looking for someone to take ownership of the digital growth journey at Karma Ventures.
 



  





 Karma is building a portfolio of real\-estate businesses across Gujarat — industrial \& logistics,
 



 workspaces, commercial real estate and new development opportunities. The role will work
 



 across Karma Ventures and its businesses, including KLIP and Karma Workspaces.
 



  





**This is not a traditional digital marketing or social media role.** 




  





 I'm looking for someone who can understand a business deeply, think commercially, build the
 



 digital strategy, work with our existing SEO / website / content partners, generate meaningful
 



 business opportunities, use data to understand what is working, and increasingly use AI and
 



 automation to make the whole system better.
 



  





 There are two parts of the role that are particularly important to me:
 



  





**1\. Make organic digital growth work.** 




 Build our SEO and organic search presence so that the right businesses and decision\-makers
 



 discover us. Use content where it has a clear purpose — across our website, Instagram,
 



 LinkedIn and other relevant channels — not simply to keep social media active. This also
 



 includes supporting Karma Ventures' digital presence and my own LinkedIn strategy and
 



 outreach — my voice stays personal; your role is to help make that presence more strategic and
 



 effective.
 



  





**2\. Create opportunities directly.** 




 Identify relevant companies and decision\-makers, build targeted prospect lists, reach out through
 



 thoughtful, targeted personal outreach and other digital channels, develop relationships and turn
 



 those conversations into genuine business opportunities.
 



  





 Around these two priorities, you'll build the infrastructure that makes the system work —
 



 websites, landing pages, analytics, CRM, lead tracking, dashboards and reporting — and use AI
 



 and automation wherever it can remove repetitive work.
 



  





 This role is focused on organic growth and direct digital business development. It is not a paid\-
 



 marketing role, and paid marketing will not sit within this role's remit.
 



 More importantly, I'm looking for someone who is self\-driven, energetic, curious and takes
 



 genuine ownership of their work. Someone who sees something that needs to be done and
 



 doesn't wait to be told what to do — but is also comfortable telling me when they think we're
 



 doing something wrong.
 



 You will have significant autonomy, with the opportunity to work closely with the founder on
 



 business priorities and digital strategy. The intention is to find someone who can grow with
 



 Karma over the long term.
 



  





**Must\-have skills** 




 •Able to understand a business model, customer, sales cycle and commercial objective before
 



 deciding what digital activity to pursue.
 



 •3–6 years in digital marketing, growth or a related commercial role, with evidence of owning
 



 outcomes.
 



 •Strong working understanding of SEO, search intent, Google Search Console and GA4\.
 



 •Good understanding of websites/CMS, landing pages and conversion optimisation.
 



 •Comfortable with CRM, lead tracking and digital analytics.
 



 •Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — comfortable working with data, using formulas, sorting/
 



 filtering datasets, creating simple analyses and dashboards, and turning the numbers into
 



 decisions.
 



 •Comfortable using LinkedIn and other digital channels for prospecting and direct business
 



 development.
 



 •Experience briefing and managing SEO, website, content, development or other external
 



 specialists.
 



 •Strong written and verbal English.
 



 •Genuine interest in AI and automation and practical application of both.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Formal qualifications matter less to us than what you've actually built, solved and owned.
 



  





**Location: Ahmedabad / Hybrid** 




 The role is based around Ahmedabad. The first three months will involve more regular in\-person
 



 interaction with the founder and team. Once the role and working rhythm are established, we are
 



 open to a hybrid arrangement — broadly around one week in Ahmedabad each month and the
 



 balance remotely. Exceptional candidates based elsewhere can also be considered.
 



  





**To apply, please send** 




**Current compensation:** 




**Expected compensation:** 




**Notice period:** 




**Location:** 




 We are open to discussing compensation for the right person based on capability, experience
 



 and fit.
 



  





 Along with short answers to these three questions:
 



 1\.Tell us about one digital/growth problem you personally solved. What did you do and what
 



 measurable result did it produce?
 



 2\.Tell us about a dashboard or reporting system you have built or managed. What information
 



 did it bring together, and how did you use it to make a decision or improve performance?
 



 3\.Imagine paid marketing is not available to you, and Karma has a strong website but very little

**Job Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an Accounts Manager – CA / CMA \| Ahmedabad to manage end\-to\-end accounting operations supporting our e\-commerce and retail distributor channels. The role involves maintaining accurate books of accounts for multi\-channel sales operations, managing distributor receivables, ensuring GST compliance across channels, and coordinating closely with Sales, Operations, and other teams. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on SAP experience and prior exposure to e\-commerce and distribution channel accounting in FMCG or retail environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Financial Management \& Accounting** 




  




* Maintain accurate books of accounts for e\-commerce and retail distributor channel operations.
* Ensure timely recording of all financial transactions related to sales and channel\-specific expenses.
* Monitor channel profitability and operational costs; analyze and report variances to management.
* Manage and reconcile distributor accounts, trade receivables, and payment collection tracking.
* Implement strong internal controls for channel transaction management and expense tracking.



  





**GST \& Tax Compliance** 




  




* Ensure comprehensive GST compliance across all sales channels (e\-commerce, distributors, direct retail).
* Manage GST classification for different product categories and sales channels.
* Oversee Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation and optimization across channels.
* Support GST return data validation (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-2, GSTR\-3B) across channel transactions.
* Ensure compliance with TDS and other statutory requirements.
* Support GST audits, assessments, and statutory filings related to channel operations.
* Maintain accurate documentation for compliance and audits.



  





**Vendor \& Distributor Coordination** 




  




* Verify purchase and distributor invoices for GST accuracy and ensure proper accounting.
* Coordinate with Sales and Channel Management teams for proper documentation and compliance.
* Support distributor billing, payment terms, and settlement processes.
* Monitor credit notes, returns, and allowances across channels.



  





**E\-Commerce Platform Management** 




  




* Manage accounting for e\-commerce platform transactions (marketplace, own website).
* Reconcile e\-commerce platform statements with accounts records.
* Track platform charges, commissions, and promotional expenses.
* Ensure proper GST treatment for different e\-commerce transaction types.
* Coordinate with digital marketing and sales on promotional spend tracking.



  





**Team Supervision \& Process Management** 




  




* Supervise accounts executives and channel accounting staff.
* Provide guidance, training, and ensure timely completion of accounting activities.
* Ensure adherence to company financial policies and procedures.
* Prepare financial reports and MIS for channel performance analysis.
* Drive process improvements and standardisation in channel accounting.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* CMA / MBA (Finance) / CA Inter / M.Com / B.Com



  





**Experience** 




  




* 5–8 years of accounting experience with mandatory exposure to multi\-channel sales operations, e\-commerce, or distribution channel accounting.
* Preferred experience in FMCG, retail, or e\-commerce companies with distributor and online sales channels.



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 




  




* **Strong GST knowledge and hands\-on compliance experience across multiple sales channels** 
 (MANDATORY)
* **SAP working knowledge** 
 (MANDATORY)
* Strong understanding of multi\-channel accounting (e\-commerce, distributor, direct retail)
* Experience with distributor receivables management and trade credit control
* Knowledge of e\-commerce platform accounting and reconciliation
* Knowledge of TDS compliance
* Ability to coordinate with cross\-functional teams (Sales, Logistics, Digital, Channel Management)



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience with marketplace platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, etc.)

description:
**About Mahila Housing Trust (MHT)** 




  





 Mahila Housing Trust (MHT) builds secure housing and resilient living environments for low\-income women and girls. Technology is central to how we drive social change — from gathering the data needed to understand urban challenges to designing solutions that reduce climate risk.
 



 MHT strengthens essential civic and housing infrastructure, including water, sanitation, drainage, solid waste management, roads, electricity/energy, low\-income housing, and secure land tenure. Using data\-driven insights, spatial analysis, and digital tools, we connect communities to financial, legal, and technical services in housing, water, sanitation, and energy. This approach keeps our work community\-driven, scalable, and evidence\-based — improving lives and livelihoods for underprivileged women.
 



 MHT runs several Climate Resilience Initiatives that tackle urban heat, climate risk, and vulnerability in low\-income communities. **Job Purpose** 




 The Bridge Design Engineer is responsible for preparing, analyzing, and finalizing structural drawings and layouts for bridge and highway infrastructure projects. The role primarily focuses on developing General Arrangement Drawings (GAD), executing Cross Drainage (CD) structure designs, and ensuring structural compliance with IRC/MoRTH codes.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Drawings \& Detailing (GAD \& CD Structures)**
* Prepare and detail General Arrangement Drawings (GAD) for minor bridges, major bridges, flyovers, ROBs, and RUBs.
* Develop detailed reinforcement and construction drawings for CD structures, including single/multi\-cell box culverts, slab culverts, and pipe culverts.
* Prepare and verify structural schedules, including Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) and structural quantity take\-offs (BOQ).
* **Hydraulic \& Alignment Integration**
* Interpret hydrological data (Design Discharge, High Flood Level \[HFL], Scour Depth, Waterway requirements) and translate them into functional GAD elevations and foundation levels.
* Coordinate with highway geometric design teams to integrate vertical profiles, horizontal curves, superelevations, and skew angles into structural layouts.
* **Code Compliance \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure all structural models, layouts, and detailing strictly comply with relevant codes: IRC:5, IRC:6, IRC:78, IRC:83, IRC:112, and MoRTH specifications.
* Conduct internal checks on drawing deliverables for dimensional accuracy, reinforcement clearances, bearing pedestals, expansion joints, and drainage details.
* **Coordination \& Approvals**
* Address and incorporate technical observations raised by Proof Consultants, Independent Engineers (IE), Authority Engineers (AE), NHAI, or State PWDs.
* Liaise with site engineers to address technical queries (RFIs) and clarify drawing details during construction.



**Candidate Profile \& Qualifications** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Civil Engineering. Master’s degree (M.E. / M.Tech) in Structural Engineering is strongly preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 2 to 4 years of proven structural drafting and design experience within an infrastructure design consultancy.
* **Technical Skills:**
* High proficiency in
 **AutoCAD** 
 (2D structural detailing, layer management, xrefs).
* Working knowledge of structural analysis software (e.g.,
 **STAAD.Pro** 
 ,
 **midas Civil** 
 ) is an asset.
* Strong working familiarity with standard IRC load classifications and standard drawing templates.
* **Competencies:** 
 Strong spatial reasoning, precision in numeric detailing, analytical problem\-solving, and clear technical communication.

This role focuses on driving occupancy in retail properties by leading the team in conducting tours, reviewing applications, and negotiating lease terms that align with both tenant needs and company objectives. The Lead also works closely with retail clients to ensure their space requirements are met, while maintaining strong tenant relationships to encourage lease renewals and long\-term occupancy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Develop and Optimize Tenant Mix for Retail Leasing:**
 Lead the development and execution of retail leasing strategies aimed at attracting a diverse mix of retailers that align with the mall’s positioning and market.
   

  

 Ensure that leasing activities drive footfall, support long\-term profitability, and enhance the mall’s status as a top retail destination.
   

  

**Market Research And Retail Prospect Identification**
 Conduct in\-depth market research to track retail trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities, using this data to strategically target retailers that appeal to mall visitors.
   

  

 Identify and approach retail brands that can help increase footfall and fill gaps in the current tenant mix to improve the mall’s retail offerings.
   

  

**Retail Tenant Negotiation And Lease Management**
 Oversee the retail leasing process from initial discussions through to agreement finalization, ensuring lease terms meet both the mall’s commercial goals and tenant needs.
   

  

 Negotiate complex retail lease terms such as rental rates, store size, fit\-outs, and terms aligned with the retailer’s business model while ensuring legal and financial compliance.
   

  

**Retail Tenant Relationship Management And Support**
 Maintain strong relationships with retail tenants, acting as their primary point of contact to resolve issues and provide support throughout their tenancy.
   

  

 Build and nurture long\-term partnerships by addressing tenant concerns and ensuring smooth lease renewals to foster a thriving retail environment.
   

  

**Collaborating On Store Openings And Retail Layouts**
 Work closely with marketing, operations, and design teams to ensure smooth store openings and optimal retail space utilization that maximizes footfall.
   

  

 Coordinate efforts to align tenant store designs with mall standards and promote visibility, creating engaging customer experiences that drive foot traffic.
   

  

**Footfall Analysis And Retail Reporting**
 Analyze retail leasing performance by tracking key metrics such as footfall, occupancy rates, and rental income, and develop strategies for the effectiveness of leasing strategies.
   

  

 Regularly report leasing data and insights to senior management, recommending adjustments to optimize space utilization and enhance mall profitability.
   

  

**Documentation And Reporting Of Retail Leasing Activities**
 Ensure that all retail leasing activities, including lease agreements, tenant correspondence, and store design approvals, are accurately documented.
   

  

 Provide regular reports on retail occupancy, footfall patterns, rental yields, and tenant sales performance, delivering valuable insights for strategic decision\-making.
   

  

**Digital Mindset**
 Promote the adoption of digital technologies and innovative solutions in Leasing initiatives for city\-side projects. Stay informed on emerging trends and best practices to leverage opportunities for transformation.
   

  

**Team Leadership And Development**
 Lead and collaborate with diverse teams (marketing, projects, design) to ensure alignment on leasing strategies and execution.

Experience working with various retail brands and understanding their space needs is crucial. Previous experience in managing leasing teams and meeting occupancy targets is highly preferred.
